actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (metabolism-low RNA, PBRM1 enrichment, CDKN2A/9p loss) and no plausible technical confounder for its molecular signal. Cross-modal structure is weak (near-zero fused silhouette, low resampling stability), but no positive structural evidence supports a reproducible split or merge, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation with this limitation noted.

C0002 shows coherent identity evidence (PBRM1-mutant, VHL-associated, BAP1-absent with distinctive CNV profile) and no set-specific technical confounder. Cross-modal support is moderate but resampling stability is low, and no positive structural evidence indicates a reproducible split or merge, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0003 has strong, coherent identity evidence (BAP1 enrichment, OR 18.1) with the highest resampling stability among sets (ARI 0.79) and WXS as the dominant positive modality, and no plausible technical confounder. No structural evidence supports subdivision or merging, so the candidate is defensible for downstream validation.

C0004 has a distinctive identity defined by VHL/PBRM1 depletion and 9p/9q/JAK2/CDKN2A gain, with no plausible technical confounder. Cross-modal coherence is weak (WXS-dominated, fused silhouette near zero), but no positive structural evidence supports a reproducible split or merge, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0005 has a coherent identity signal (universal VHL mutation with PBRM1 depletion) and no plausible technical confounder for the genomic signal. The set is small with WXS-dominated structure and uninformative RNA/CNV, but no positive structural evidence supports a reproducible split or merge, so it is retained for downstream validation.
